title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty: Probabilistic Load Forecasting by Mixing Compact Adaptations
note: Abstract page, v1 of 6 Oct 2026, cs.LG, CC BY 4.0. A shared probabilistic forecaster plus a small bank of low-rank adaptations that each customer or transformer load mixes. Says results on 590 SMART-DS load profiles improve deterministic and probabilistic scores over statistical, neural, Transformer and pretrained baselines at low storage and inference cost. One version only.

title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty (full text, v1)
note: Setup: 590 residential, commercial and industrial profiles from SMART-DS 2018 (synthetic distribution-system loads), 15-minute data summed to hourly, 4 kW to above 128 kW. Train Jan-Oct, validate Nov, test Dec 2018. Each midnight a 24-hour forecast from 168 h of history: 30 origins per profile, 17,700 daily forecasts. The experiments section does not say which external inputs, if any, were fed.

title: MuhaoGuo/M2oE2 (Hugging Face model page)
note: Model page linked from the repository README for the earlier M2oE2 model. The fetched page shows an empty model card: no description, licence, file list or dates were returned, so nothing about weights for this paper's model can be read from it.

title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty (full text, v1)
note: Table II, December test: M2oE2-mLoRA MSE 2.72e-3, RMSE 4.50 kW, MAE 1.60 kW, WAPE 4.16%, CRPS 1.18 kW, quantile score 0.48, Winkler-90 11.01. M2oE2 without adapters: MSE 2.98, CRPS 1.32. Chronos-2 zero-shot: MSE 3.21, WAPE 5.07, CRPS 1.48. TimesFM-2.5 zero-shot 3.74 and 1.80; with LoRA 3.15 and 1.37. Text: MSE 8.72% under M2oE2, 13.65% under TimesFM-2.5 + LoRA.

title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty (full text, v1)
note: Method and cost: a GRU-based variational backbone (M2oE2) is trained on all loads and frozen; only its mean and variance output heads get low-rank updates, 15 cluster-level adapters mixed per load. 0.11 ms per forecast on a Tesla T4 and 0.58 MiB, against 10.15 ms and 456 MiB for Chronos-2. No intervals, seeds or significance tests; cluster count picked on November MSE.

title: haorandd/M2oE2_load_forecast (repository linked from the paper)
note: The repository the paper links as its code. MIT licence, 91 commits, latest 24 Sep 2026 (12 days before the preprint), no releases. The README describes the earlier M2oE2 model (temperature, workday and season as context), links a Hugging Face data set and model and a Zenodo data record, and adds a GEFCom2014 day-ahead table. It does not mention SMART-DS or a mixture of adapters.

title: M2oE2_load_forecast/code (file listing and README)
note: Code folder: M2oE2 scripts, a single-adapter LoRA utility from Nov 2025, recurrent, iTransformer and ARIMA baselines, one GEFCom2014 checkpoint. Its README covers the earlier M2oE2-GL work on Oncor transformer data and a later base-only variant fed a 24-hour future temperature block. Nothing listed names SMART-DS, clustering, mixed adapters, Chronos-2 or TimesFM.
